commerce::which customers owe us money.sql:

commerce::late shipments by carrier.sql:
SELECT c.id AS id_carrier,
       c.name AS carrier_name,
       c.scac_code,
       c.service_level,
       COUNT(s.id) AS total_shipments,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'delayed'
                 OR (s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND s.promised_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at > s.promised_at)
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_shipments,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'delayed'
                 OR (s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND s.promised_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at > s.promised_at)
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS late_pct
FROM main.ship_carrier c
JOIN main.ship_shipment s ON s.id_carrier = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.scac_code, c.service_level
ORDER BY late_shipments DESC, carrier_name

commerce::unpaid invoices over 90 days o.sql:
SELECT i.id,
       i.invoice_number,
       c.account_number,
       p.display_name AS customer_name,
       i.issued_on,
       i.due_on,
       i.currency,
       i.total_gross,
       COALESCE(pay.paid, 0) AS paid,
       COALESCE(cn.credited, 0) AS credited,
       i.total_gross - COALESCE(pay.paid, 0) - COALESCE(cn.credited, 0) AS outstanding,
       CAST(julianday('now') - julianday(i.issued_on) AS INTEGER) AS age_days
FROM main.billing_invoice i
JOIN main.crm_customer c ON c.id = i.id_customer
JOIN main.core_party p ON p.id = c.id_party
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT id_invoice, SUM(amount) AS paid
    FROM main.billing_payment
    WHERE status = 'settled'
    GROUP BY id_invoice
) pay ON pay.id_invoice = i.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT id_invoice, SUM(amount) AS credited
    FROM main.billing_credit_note
    GROUP BY id_invoice
) cn ON cn.id_invoice = i.id
WHERE julianday('now') - julianday(i.issued_on) > 90
  AND i.total_gross - COALESCE(pay.paid, 0) - COALESCE(cn.credited, 0) > 0
ORDER BY age_days DESC, outstanding DESC

telemetry::what needs a technician visit.sql:
WITH latest_cal AS (
    SELECT sensor_id, MAX(performed_on) AS last_performed_on
    FROM main.ops_calibration
    GROUP BY sensor_id
),
cal_due AS (
    SELECT s.device_id                AS device_id,
           d.serial_number            AS serial_number,
           'calibration due'          AS reason,
           'sensor ' || s.sensor_id || ' (' || s.measurement || ') due ' || c.next_due_on AS detail,
           c.next_due_on              AS due_on
    FROM main.ops_calibration c
    JOIN latest_cal lc
      ON lc.sensor_id = c.sensor_id
     AND lc.last_performed_on = c.performed_on
    JOIN main.dev_sensor s ON s.sensor_id = c.sensor_id
    JOIN main.dev_device d ON d.device_id = s.device_id
    WHERE c.next_due_on IS NOT NULL
      AND date(c.next_due_on) <= date('now', '+30 day')
),
silent AS (
    SELECT v.device_id,
           v.serial_number,
           'device silent'  AS reason,
           'last seen ' || COALESCE(v.last_seen_at, 'never') AS detail,
           date(v.last_seen_at) AS due_on
    FROM main.v_silent_devices v
),
open_wo AS (
    SELECT w.device_id,
           d.serial_number,
           'open work order' AS reason,
           w.work_order_number || ' (' || w.category || ') opened ' || w.opened_on AS detail,
           date(w.opened_on) AS due_on
    FROM main.ops_work_order w
    JOIN main.dev_device d ON d.device_id = w.device_id
    WHERE w.status IN ('open', 'pending')
      AND w.closed_on IS NULL
),
unacked AS (
    SELECT s.device_id,
           d.serial_number,
           'unacknowledged alarm' AS reason,
           a.severity || ' alarm ' || a.alarm_id || ' raised ' || a.raised_at AS detail,
           date(a.raised_at) AS due_on
    FROM main.tel_alarm_raised a
    JOIN main.dev_sensor s ON s.sensor_id = a.sensor_id
    JOIN main.dev_device d ON d.device_id = s.device_id
    LEFT JOIN main.tel_alarm_ack k ON k.alarm_id = a.alarm_id
    WHERE k.ack_id IS NULL
      AND a.severity IN ('critical', 'high')
),
all_needs AS (
    SELECT * FROM cal_due
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM silent
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM open_wo
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM unacked
)
SELECT n.device_id,
       n.serial_number,
       n.reason,
       n.detail,
       n.due_on,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY n.device_id) AS total_flags_for_device
FROM all_needs n
ORDER BY total_flags_for_device DESC, n.device_id, n.due_on

finance::what do we owe and what is owed.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    b.account_id,
    b.balance_date,
    b.closing_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.account_id ORDER BY b.balance_date DESC, b.balance_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM main.gl_daily_balance b
)
SELECT
  a.account_code,
  a.account_name,
  a.account_type,
  a.currency,
  l.balance_date AS as_of_date,
  CASE
    WHEN lower(a.account_type) LIKE '%liab%' OR lower(a.account_type) LIKE '%payable%'
      THEN 'we owe'
    WHEN lower(a.account_type) LIKE '%asset%' OR lower(a.account_type) LIKE '%receivable%'
      THEN 'owed to us'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS direction,
  l.closing_balance AS balance
FROM latest l
JOIN main.ref_chart_of_accounts a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.rn = 1
ORDER BY direction, a.account_code

       i.ticker,
       i.name AS instrument_name,
       c.name AS counterparty_name,
       e.entity_code,
       e.name AS entity_name,
       s.settlement_id,
       s.settled_on,
       s.status AS settlement_status,
       s.fail_reason
FROM main.trd_trade t
LEFT JOIN main.ref_instrument i ON i.instrument_id = t.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN main.dim_counterparty c ON c.counterparty_id = t.counterparty_id
LEFT JOIN main.ref_legal_entity e ON e.entity_id = t.entity_id
LEFT JOIN main.trd_settlement s ON s.trade_id = t.trade_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM main.trd_settlement s2
        WHERE s2.trade_id = t.trade_id
          AND s2.status = 'settled'
      )
ORDER BY t.trade_date, t.trade_id, s.settlement_id

finance::how much are we on the hook for.sql:
SELECT c.counterparty_id,
       c.name AS counterparty_name,
       c.country,
       c.rating,
       t.currency,
       COUNT(*) AS trade_count,
       SUM(t.notional) AS total_notional
FROM main.trd_trade t
JOIN main.dim_counterparty c
  ON c.counterparty_id = t.counterparty_id
WHERE LOWER(c.sector) LIKE '%bank%'
  AND t.status <> 'void'
GROUP BY c.counterparty_id, c.name, c.country, c.rating, t.currency
ORDER BY total_notional DESC

SELECT sl.id AS shipment_line_id,
       sl.id_order,
       sl.line_no,
       ol.id_product,
       ol.quantity AS ordered_qty,
       sl.shipped_qty,
       ol.unit_price,

hostile::device alarm thresholds.sql:
SELECT d.id AS device_id,
       d.device_number,
       r.id AS reading_id,
       r.reading_number,
       a.id AS alarm_id,
       a.alarm_number,
       tp.id AS threshold_profile_id,
       tp.threshold_profile_number,
       tp.amount AS threshold_amount,
       tp.quantity AS threshold_quantity,
       tp.status AS threshold_status,
       tp.type AS threshold_type
FROM main.telemetry_device d
JOIN main.telemetry_reading r ON r.id_device = d.id
JOIN main.telemetry_alarm a ON a.id_reading = r.id

ORDER BY d.device_number, r.reading_number, a.alarm_number, tp.threshold_profile_number

hostile::commission and quota by territo.sql:
SELECT t.id AS territory_id,
       t.territory_number,
       COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) AS quota_count,
       SUM(q.amount) AS quota_amount,
       COUNT(c.id) AS commission_count,
       SUM(c.amount) AS commission_amount
FROM main.sales_territory t
LEFT JOIN main.sales_quota q ON q.id_territory = t.id
LEFT JOIN main.sales_commission c ON c.id_quota = q.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.territory_number
ORDER BY commission_amount DESC
